raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating the accuracy percentages (%) of five different reinforcement learning-based methods across three benchmark datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis (y-axis) represents accuracy, ranging from 50% to 62%, marked in increments of 2 percentage points, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis (x-axis) displays the three datasets in the order: Mathverse, MMLU, Physics. For each dataset, there are five bars corresponding to the methods: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes), as indicated in the legend. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each method represented by a distinct color and pattern. In the Mathverse dataset, the DAPO+Self-reflection method achieves approximately 56.2% accuracy, while DAPO is around 53.2%, GRPO is about 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection is approximately 54.5%, and PPO is around 53.3%. In the MMLU dataset, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 56.8%, DAPO is around 56.0%, GRPO is about 55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection is approximately 56.2%, and PPO is around 54.5%. In the Physics dataset, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 61.2%, followed by SRPO (solid orange) at about 60.8%, DAPO at approximately 57.6%, GRPO at around 58.2%, and PPO at approximately 57.0%. The bars are arranged in the same order for each dataset, corresponding to the legend, and no visual emphasis such as highlighting or additional annotations is applied to any specific bar.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: 该图表为一个分组柱状图，用于展示不同方法在三个基准数据集（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）上的准确率（Accuracy, %）表现。水平轴（x轴）表示三个类别：Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics，按从左到右的顺序排列；垂直轴（y轴）表示准确率，标签为“Accuracy (%)”，刻度为线性，范围从50%到62%，以2%为间隔标注（50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62）。每个数据集类别下包含五个分组柱状图，分别对应五种方法：DAPO+Self-reflection（蓝色实心）、GRPO（橙色斜纹）、DAPO（浅蓝斜纹）、PPO+Self-reflection（深绿实心）和PPO（浅绿斜纹），其颜色和图案在图例中明确标注。在Mathverse数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection的准确率约为56.2%，GRPO约为53.4%，DAPO约为53.0%，PPO+Self-reflection约为54.4%，PPO约为53.2%。在MMLU数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection约为56.8%，GRPO约为55.8%，DAPO约为55.9%，PPO+Self-reflection约为56.2%，PPO约为54.6%。在Physics数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection达到最高值约61.2%，GRPO约为58.2%，DAPO约为57.6%，PPO+Self-reflection约为59.0%，PPO约为56.8%。柱状图在每个数据集类别内按方法标签顺序排列，未见特殊视觉强调（如加粗或阴影），所有柱状图高度均按实际数值呈现，无明显趋势或比较标注。
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of five different reinforcement learning methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmark datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three datasets in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with tick marks at 2% intervals (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Each dataset has a group of five bars, each corresponding to one method, distinguished by color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection is solid blue, GRPO is orange with diagonal stripes, DAPO is light blue with diagonal stripes, PPO+Self-reflection is solid dark green, and PPO is teal with diagonal stripes. For Mathverse, the accuracies are approximately 53% (DAPO), 56% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 53.5% (GRPO), 53.5% (PPO), and 54.5% (PPO+Self-reflection). For MMLU, the accuracies are approximately 56% (DAPO), 57% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 56% (GRPO), 57% (SRPO), 55% (PPO), and 56.5% (PPO+Self-reflection). For Physics, the accuracies are approximately 57.5% (DAPO), 61% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 58.5% (GRPO), 61% (SRPO), 57% (PPO), and 59% (PPO+Self-reflection). The bars are arranged in the same order for each dataset, with DAPO+Self-reflection consistently achieving the highest accuracy in Physics and MMLU, and GRPO and PPO showing lower performance across all datasets. The chart does not highlight or annotate any specific bars, and the bars are not sorted by height within each group.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm ist ein gruppiertes Balkendiagramm, das die Genauigkeit (%) verschiedener Verfahren in drei unterschiedlichen Bewertungskategorien – Mathverse, MMLU und Physics – vergleicht. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die drei Kategorien in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert die Genauigkeit in Prozent, mit einem Wertebereich von 50 bis 62, wobei die Skala linear ist und in Schritten von 2% beschriftet ist (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Für jede Kategorie sind fünf Balken gruppiert, die jeweils einem Verfahren entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (dunkelblau, fest gefüllt), DAPO (hellblau, diagonal gestreift), GRPO (orange, diagonal gestreift), PPO+Self-reflection (dunkelgrün, fest gefüllt) und PPO (hellgrün, diagonal gestreift). In der Kategorie Mathverse liegen die Werte bei etwa 53% (DAPO), 56% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 53% (GRPO), 53% (PPO) und 54% (PPO+Self-reflection). In MMLU sind die Werte etwa 56% (DAPO), 57% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 56% (GRPO), 57% (SRPO), 55% (PPO) und 56% (PPO+Self-reflection). In Physics erreichen die Werte etwa 57% (DAPO), 61% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 58% (GRPO), 61% (SRPO), 57% (PPO) und 59% (PPO+Self-reflection). Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet, ohne visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken. Die Legende befindet sich oben im Diagramm und ordnet jedem Verfahren eine eindeutige Farbe und Musterkombination zu. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern entsprechen der Reihenfolge in der Legende.
